summary: Verified both reported visual bugs on the Provider Price Checker result view are fixed. BUG 1 (pc-position overflow): heading wraps and is fully visible at both desktop (1440px) and narrow mobile (390px) widths with no horizontal clipping or page overflow. BUG 2 (card distinction): pc-stat-charged renders teal-tinted bg, pc-range renders plum-tinted bg, pc-your-share renders a distinct tint (sage in the clinical-mode case tested, clay/terracotta in default/band/unavailable/picker modes per code) — three cards visually distinguishable. Regression check: end-to-end flow (login → price-checker form → submit high rate → quality guard dismissed → result rendered) runs without console or page errors. Minor finding: the intended coloured left-accent border on pc-stat-charged and pc-range is currently overridden by `border-kindred` from the same class list, so the 5px left bar paints in grey instead of teal/plum (background tint still carries the visual distinction).

design_issues.screen: Provider Price Checker result cards (pc-stat-charged, pc-range, pc-range-unavailable)
issues: Computed border-left-color on pc-stat-charged resolves to kindred grey rgb(226,231,236) instead of #0E4D52 (teal). Same for pc-range / pc-range-unavailable — the 5px left-accent bar paints grey instead of plum #5F4E76. Cause: Tailwind class order — `border border-kindred` emits `border-color` which overrides the later `border-l-[#0E4D52]` / `border-l-[#5F4E76]` border-left-color because of generated-utility ordering. Backgrounds still provide clear colour distinction so the user complaint (cards all looked the same) is resolved. Fix: either drop `border-kindred` from these three cards and set each side explicitly, or use `[border-left-color:#0E4D52]` arbitrary-property to raise specificity, or reorder so colour utilities come after border-kindred in the className string isn't enough — Tailwind utilities share specificity, so moving border-kindred into a conditional/variant that doesn't touch the left side (e.g. `border-y border-r border-kindred`) is the cleanest fix.

action_items: (Optional / low priority) Fix the three stat-card left-accent bars so they render in their intended brand colours (teal / clay / plum) rather than kindred grey — the border-kindred utility is overriding border-l-[color]. Suggested fix: replace `border border-kindred border-l-[5px] border-l-[<color>]` with `border-y border-r border-kindred border-l-[5px] border-l-[<color>]` on pc-stat-charged, pc-range, and pc-range-unavailable (PriceCheckerTool.jsx lines ~786, 794, 889). The StatCard component also needs updating. The default/band/picker/unavailable ShareStatCard variants on pc-your-share have the same pattern and should get the same fix.
critical_code_review_comments: PriceCheckerTool.jsx is 1006 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting sub-components (CapDeferralNote, GrandfatheredGate, QualityGuardPanel, NonCheckablePanel, ResultCard, StatCard, ShareStatCard, HowThisWorksPanel) into their own files to improve maintainability.

rca of the issue: BUG 1 root cause was `whitespace-nowrap` on a long sentence inside a flex container — fixed by removing it and adding `break-words`. BUG 2 root cause was all three stat cards using the same `bg-primary-k/5` tint — fixed by giving each card an explicit brand-tinted background (teal/clay/plum at 10% alpha). Verified via computed-style introspection and screenshots at desktop + 390px mobile widths.
